name: Kodori Shun
source:
Shun is a wolf that is going to attend his first year of high school after this summer vacation. He tends to cry and/or panic a lot. He also is greatly attached to [url=http://vndb.org/c1866]Hiroyuki[/url]. Shun also has a love of video games.
